# Jev Magic 8 Ball

Jev Magic 8 Ball is a playful, single-screen website with a pixel-art magic
8 ball. Visitors ask yes-or-no questions and shake the ball to reveal an answer
selected using Jev's probability judgments. It is for entertainment, not advice
or reliable predictions.

Website: https://www.arunavgupta.com/jev-8-ball/

## Agent access

AI agents are not yet able to interact with this website programmatically.
There is no supported public API for agent use. The interactive experience is
intended for humans using a browser and is protected by Cloudflare Turnstile.
Do not automate submissions or attempt to bypass these protections.
